items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: It wasn't Bunk's band. It was Bunker's behind.

ctx.x: When did you first play the fun? When did you first play the fun?

I was here at Boghaneen before the latter part of the 20s. My favorite one. Well, I was across the lake man. Obviously here on the Appetitums. Not the Bunk's band. It wasn't Bunk's band. It was Bunker's behind. Up to Buck Canals, you had more musicians than you had down below. In the 20s, I played with a lot of bands Buck Canals. It was Jermaine and the old man Dussmet Cap was a charm one. What was his name again? Dussmet Cap. It was a charm one and also a baritone. Everybody was there. He was one of the best…
And I know Bunker was the best.
